title: Doc-Sync Repository Configuration (.doc-sync.yml)
description: Schema for per-repository Markdown-to-Confluence synchronization config.

base_url_secret.description: Name of the environment/org secret holding the Confluence base URL (never the raw URL).

auth_secret.description: Name of the environment/org secret holding the Confluence PAT/token (never the raw secret).

username_secret.description: Optional name of the secret holding the service account email for Basic Auth.

force_overwrite.description: When false (safe default), direct edits in Confluence block sync with a conflict error.

add_source_banner.description: Prepend an info panel warning readers that the page is auto-generated from Git.

on_missing_file.description: Behavior when a mapped Markdown file or glob does not match any non-empty files.

agent_review.description: Enable optional advisory pre-sync AI diff summary and conflict merge suggestions.

source.description: Repo-relative path or glob pattern to Markdown file(s), e.g. README.md or docs/**/*.md.

confluence_page_id.description: Exact target Confluence page ID for a 1:1 mapping.

confluence_parent_page_id.description: Parent Confluence page ID under which child pages are located/created (used with globs).

title_from.description: How to derive page title when `title` is not set (e.g. `h1` extracts first # Heading).

labels.description: Optional Confluence labels to apply on publish.

slack_webhook_secret.description: Optional secret name for a Slack webhook to alert on conflict or failure.
